bling_late_night.title: Bling Bling King, Late
bling_late_night.//: Story Phase 11: a late-night comedy programme hosted, from behind a desk, by the Bling Bling King (on television it talks; in person it never has). It knows things it can't know: the hammock over the captain, the Finger-Puller vote, the toy sashes. Nobody explains how. Original jokes; the cast are extra speakers.

episodes.//: Watched in the galley (chapter 109): the designated fart man, the benefits package, fartocracy, sleeping above the captain.

beats.line: announcer: IT'S LATE! IT'S LIVE! IT'S... THE BLING BLING KING, LATE!
bling_king_tv: Thank you. Thank you. Lovely crowd. Lovely STORM out there tonight.
bling_king_tv: So I've been asking myself, folks. Why does a pirate ship have a designated FART MAN?
bling_king_tv: Every other ship's got a cook. A carpenter. A surgeon. This one's got a man whose whole job is the one thing EVERYBODY can already do.
bling_king_tv: And the BENEFITS package. Free beans. Nap authority. A crown. A sash.
bling_king_tv: A pension. For when he retires. From what, folks? From WHAT?
bling_king_tv: They call it an office. I call it a FARTOCRACY.
bling_king_tv: And where does he sleep? In a hammock. Directly. Over. The CAPTAIN.
bling_king_tv: That's not a chain of command, folks. That's a weather system.

episodes.//: On while the captain fights the knobs (and on the channel after): the Grand Court, the Finger-Puller, Hold My Sash, and an advertisement for the Cheap-O-Rama playset.

beats.line: bling_king_tv: Now. The Grand Court. A COURT, folks. For farts. With a JUDGE.
bling_king_tv: 'The Grand Waft is valid.' Who's checking? Who's out there in a wig checking VALIDITY?
bling_king_tv: And they're HIRING. Grand Finger-Puller. No experience. Zero accountability. Sounds like management.
announcer: And now, a sketch. HOLD MY SASH!
bling_king_tv: (in a little cartoon sash) Hold my sash, boys. I'm going IN.
cheapo_voice: Kids! Is your Grand Waft IMAGINARY? Then you need the GRAND STENCHMASTER CEREMONIAL SASH PLAYSET!
cheapo_voice: Two smiling sash holders! Pretend fart noises! Flutter instructions! No real flatulence required!
cheapo_voice: CHEAP-O-RAMA DISCOUNT EMPORIUM. We deliver ANYWHERE.
bling_king_tv: We'll be right back. Don't touch that dial. I MEAN it.
